For an irrotational electric field, the voltage is independent of the path between the two points `a` and `b`. See IEC 60050-121, item 121-11-27.\n         "))) (authored (membership (kind feature) (visibility default)) (relationships (featureTyping (reference "ElectricPotentialDifferenceValue")) (subsetting (reference "scalarQuantities")))))
